title: [Performance] Drop the redundant KDA padding mask in recurrent_kda for GLM5.3flash
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?
The KDA recurrent step zeroed graph-capacity padding rows with a full [1, T, H, D] masked_fill on every layer and every decode step. None of the consumers read those rows:

- the spec/MTP path merges with index_copy_, which copies valid token rows only, and the destination was zeroed beforehand;
- the pure-decode path passes output_buffer, and write_recurrent_output already copies valid rows and zeroes all captured padding in one launch;
- the mixed prefill+decode path takes chunk_kda output as-is, which never masked its padding either.
### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
NO.
### How was this patch tested?

Precision:
We tested this PR on two datasets; on Gsm8k the score is 97.27 and on AIME26 the score is 93.33%.
Performance:
10.6us can be saved in one-time forward(1.08ms).


- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c0b6f74bee518aeaf5d72b200a0216e72fbb5e7c
